## Fixed

- Keep the activity indicator centered below the app icon while it expands from gray to blue and contracts again. Interrupted transitions remain smooth, and Reduce Motion applies the final state immediately.
- Update the active-window button without waiting for the full window inventory when switching between windows of the same app on different monitors. Late inventory responses no longer restore an older focus highlight.

## Verification

The complete test suite, focused regressions, constrained-executor checks, WindowLab replays and Apple Silicon Release build pass. Regression tests detect both original defects and deliberately removed focus-ordering and owner-validation safeguards. No new permissions, dependencies or global input observers.
